findings.detail: removePartial calls DocumentsContract.deleteDocument on any returned content URI without independently establishing newly created operation-owned destination. Cleanup can run before any write; cancellation can call deletion twice. Correct ownership and idempotence before integration; never delete arbitrary user files.

Dedicated request-code range and finishActivity exist only as drafts. Cleanup waits two seconds for a result and may seal owner on timeout; late callback can update destination after close. Request-code collision with other bridge consumers and actual picker/result ordering are unverified.

close waits indefinitely for actual picker detachment while repeatedly synchronizing with main queue. If detachment never completes, worker and queued cancellation/retirement replies can remain pending.

OS destination is read for verification, never deleted. Cleanup unlinks owned private temp source file/directory; residue cleanup uses bounded diagnostic namespace and regular-file/link/size checks. Cancellation after OS copy can leave user-owned destination, so UI/result semantics need review.

TS/controller/UI wiring unfinished. Neither platform candidate compiled or tested. Exact-byte schema agreement, original adult authority, cancellation and lifecycle require focused review and verification. No specific compiler success or failure claimed.

iOSManifestPins: Both candidate size/SHA256 pins verified. Patch archived as draft; applying or reconstructing exact candidate bytes from patch NOT_TESTED.
freezeCheck: All ten candidate SHA256 values unchanged across repeated inspection passes. Reviewer did not edit candidates or product.
